LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Veteran_1: {PAWN} cleared a scav den squatting on an old research site and stripped it before anyone else could.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Veteran_2: {PAWN} tracked down a rumored tech cache, fought off the ferals guarding it, and hauled out what was left intact.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the run cataloging a collapsed facility, marking what's worth a return trip.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back with a cracked visor and a pre-War terminal that still boots.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Elite_1: {PAWN} went in alone where a squad would've drawn too much attention, and came out with the objective secured.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the operation exactly to plan - in, recover the tech, out before anything organized a response.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks in hostile territory and returned with data worth the Protector's attention.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Outcast_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just filed the recovered tech and asked for a debrief later.
